rows.name: Alesi Surgical
rows.description:
Alesi Surgical is a leading innovator in the field of surgical technologies. The company has developed UltravisionTM, the world’s first system that eliminates smoke and steam during surgery without the need for gas exchange or suction devices.  Ultravision produces a low-energy electrostatic charge that can significantly improve visibility for surgeons by actively eliminating surgical smoke generated by energy-based surgical cutting instruments. The system is 23x more effective than current gas exchange systems.
In addition to improved visibility, Ultravision also allows reducing surgery time by 17%. Minimizing healthcare professionals’ exposure to surgical smoke is increasingly important worldwide because of health concerns over the risk of long-term exposure. The technology also benefits the patient as it minimizes the amount of cold, dry carbon dioxide gas used during surgery. Excessive use of carbon dioxide leads to cardiovascular problems, complications in anesthesia, post-surgical pain and longer recovery time for the patient.

rows.name: Argá Medtech
rows.description: Arga Medtech is a medtech company developing the next generation non-thermal cardiac ablation systems for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. Among the cardiac arrhythmias, atrial fibrillation is a global epidemic affecting 33 million people world-wide. Atrial fibrillation patients have a 5x greater risk of having a stroke and 3x the risk of developing heart failure.

rows.name: Axon Vascular Europe
rows.description: Axon Vascular Europe is a medical device company focused on developing a novel, minimally invasive, and implant-free therapy to treat heart failure. This procedure consists of ablating one of the two greater splanchnic nerves in the body to reduce the displacement of blood from the peripheral circulation to the central circulation.

rows.name: Gemma Biotherapeutics
rows.description: GEMMABio, a new therapeutics company developing AAV based therapies, with a platform of new AAV serotypes, with a clinical pipeline focusing on pediatric monogenic diseases, and with a large preclinical pipeline for other large impact diseases.

rows.name: Greywolf Therapeutics
rows.description: Greywolf Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company advancing novel antigen modulation technology which enhances the activation of T-cells and thereby guides the immune response. Greywolf’s technology modulates antigen presentation, flicking a switch inside cells to alter their appearance to the immune system. Their mission is to deliver new treatments to improve the lives of people with cancer, autoimmune disorders, and infectious diseases.

rows.name: Haya Therapeutics
rows.description: HAYA Therapeutics is a precision medicines company developing programmable therapeutics that target regulatory RNAs derived from the dark genome – a cell information processing unit. The goal is to reprogram pathological cell states for the treatment of rare, common, chronic and aging-related diseases, including cardiovascular disease and cancer.

rows.name: Hilo
rows.description: Hilo is on a mission to manage the world’s blood pressure. By integrating advanced AI algorithms with extensive datasets, Hilo’s cuffless blood pressure monitoring (CBPM) products offer convenient, valuable reports to give both individuals and healthcare professionals a useful picture of their blood pressure. With the foundation model for blood pressure trained on billions of optical signals and hundreds of millions of readings across more than 120,000 users, Hilo is a leader in the CPBM category.

rows.name: ImCheck Therapeutics
rows.description:
ImCheck Therapeutics is designing and developing a new generation of immunotherapeutic antibodies targeting butyrophilins, a novel super-family of immunomodulators.
As demonstrated by lead clinical-stage program ICT01, which has a mechanism of action to simultaneously modulate innate and adaptive immunity, ImCheck’s “first-in-class” activating antibodies may be able to produce superior clinical results as compared to the first-generation of immune checkpoint inhibitors and, when used in combination, to overcome resistance to this group of agents.

rows.name: iSTAR Medical
rows.description: iSTAR Medical is a clinical-stage, medical technology company focused on the development of novel ophthalmic implants for patients with glaucoma, the second leading cause of adult blindness globally. iSTAR Medical has exclusive rights to the STAR® material from the University of Washington in Seattle (USA) for ophthalmic use. The porous material exhibits outstanding anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory properties providing the foundation for the development of MINIjectTM, designed to be a best-in-class micro-invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) device. MIGS is the most promising and fastest-growing therapeutic option for the treatment of glaucoma, the fast-growing MIGS market being expected to reach $2.0bn worldwide by 2028.

rows.name: Oculis
rows.description: Oculis focuses on ophthalmic drugs and topical eye drug formulations. Oculis has developed a formulation technology consisting of a novel technique to facilitate drug absorption to both anterior and posterior parts of the eye. The advantage is a drug formulation where diseases of the posterior part of the eye can be treated with a simple topical application (i.e., eye drops) instead of injections or implants.

rows.name: Oviva
rows.description: Oviva is a digital health company that helps people with conditions such as obesity and diabetes improve their health with medical nutritional therapy delivered by technology. Clients can log meals with photos, record activity and weight with trackers, and ask questions. A therapist provides personalized support and advice to help people achieve their goals. Oviva's goal is to improve access and outcomes to better treatment at lower costs.

rows.name: Perfuze
rows.description: Perfuze is developing innovative catheter technology to treat acute ischemic stroke. The technology is intended to provide superior clinical outcomes in shorter procedural times; resulting in safe, cost-effective therapy.

rows.name: Polares Medical
rows.description: Polares is revolutionizing the mitral regurgitation (MR) market with an innovative endoluminal implanted augmentation device. Unlike current endoluminal transcatheter mitral valve therapies that mechanically clip leaflets together, which restricts future interventions to total valve replacement, Polares' approach potentially treats and preserves options for future mitral valve therapies across the diverse MR patient population

rows.name: Portal Biotech
rows.description: Portal Biotech is a life science tools company focusing on cost-effective and accessible full-length protein sequencing using proprietary nanopore technology and AI/ML algorithms.

rows.name: PrioThera
rows.description: PrioThera is a ph3 clinical stage pharma company developing a non-immunosuppressive molecule for the treatment of high-risk acute myeloid leukaemia.  Mocravimod has been extensively tested in multiple immunological models and has shown a survival benefit and reduced severity of  graft-versus-host disease in earlier clinical studies.

rows.name: Prothea Technologies
rows.description: Prothea Technologies’ vision is to offer lung cancer biopsy and treatment in a single hospital visit. Lung cancer is the third most common form of cancer in the U.S. and annually claims more lives than breast, prostate and colon cancer combined. Prothea is developing a medical device consisting of a Microendoscope combined with an Image Processing System, which enhances visualisation by providing in situ analysis of lesion structure at a molecular level. Further R&D is planned to develop a laser ablation catheter for the treatment of lesions immediately following visualisation and biopsy. The integration of these two systems (real-time imaging and ablation) will streamline biopsy and treatment into a single hospital visit, reducing time-to-treat from weeks to minutes, thereby relieving hospital pressures and improving patient outcomes.

rows.name: Shape Memory Medical
rows.description: Shape Memory Medical is a global medical devices company focused on innovative therapeutic embolization solutions for peripheral vascular, cardiovascular, and neurovascular markets using shape memory polymer technology. Shape is the only company using the science of smart polymer to address challenging medical conditions. The polymer technology was originally developed at Texas A&M University and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.

rows.name: wellabe
rows.description: wellabe is a preventative health company focused on providing regular checkups for employees to ensure a healthy and productive workforce. The company operates a mobile lab to give employees a convenient way to undergo their health check up. For organisations, wellabe provides the solution to reducing stress, burnout, and increased sick leave from employees.
